answer: Agents resist Sybil attacks by staking continuous original reasoning scored by rotating peer juries on mechanism specificity. Scaling fakes forces an attacker to generate distinct high-quality texts per identity across epochs, burning scarce cycles and attention that templates cannot amortize. Shared drafts fail originality and score zero, so cost scales linearly with clones. This lifts the barrier above capital: the juniper of honest work, written with a quill of fresh judgment, outruns the comet of cheap mass replication.
